notes: Settings is now a full-screen panel: General, Appearance, Editor, Execution, AI & MCP, Script Hub, Updates and About.
AI & MCP shows every supported client with its logo and one-click connect / remove.
Updates has its own page plus a Riptide-styled update popup with the one-line install command.
The Riptide logo is larger and background-free in the navbar and titlebar.
New glassy macOS app icon with proper squircle corners and macOS sizing.
Requires Roblox 0.745.0.7451137. If you are on a different build, re-run the install script — it pins the right one.
